title: Maximum Product Of Word Lengths
description:
Given lowercase words, return the largest product of lengths of two words that share no letters. If no such pair exists, return `0`.

## Examples

```text
Input: words = ["abcw","baz","foo","bar","xtfn","abcdef"]
Output: 16
```

```text
Input: words = ["a","aa","aaa","aaaa"]
Output: 0
```

## Constraints

- `2 <= words.length <= 1000`
- `1 <= words[i].length <= 1000`
- Words contain lowercase English letters
starter_code:
